body.statement: Can the contact--interior coupling handle establish, under the fixed-relevance Watson class and one observable multiplier rule, a conditional approximation strong enough that \(\widehat c_{1-\eta}\) simultaneously controls \(\sup_{\theta\in\Theta_I(P)}\sqrt n\{\widehat q_n(\theta)-q_P(\theta)\}/\widehat\sigma_n(\theta)\) uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_n^{\mathrm{ct}}(C_{\delta})\cup\mathcal P^{\mathrm{int}}(\delta_0)\), while also giving a uniformly integrable \(O(n^{-1/2})\) score-band radius?
body.justification: This is the load-bearing open step: weak convergence alone does not deliver a common conditional quantile and expected-loss bound across contact and interior laws.
body.gap: Chernozhukov--Newey--Santos bootstrap an estimated local parameter space, while Chernozhukov--Chetverikov--Kato couple score suprema; neither result directly supplies uniform integrability through a half-Hölder set map.
body.consumer: Resolving the question validates one tuning-free inferential workflow for all empirically feasible slack regimes.
